correctness.rationale: Each 9-vertex noncover component is enumerated by two independent tests: 298 faces with face vector (1,9,36,81,108,54,9). The standard-library verifier constructs two matchings in each component, 143 pairs each, with exactly one critical 0-face and ten critical 3-faces, and certifies directed acyclicity across all 1080 Hasse incidences. A single 0-cell and only 3-cells give the integral wedge of ten 3-spheres by discrete Morse theory. A verified side-interchanging automorphism makes the components isomorphic. Direct mod-two ranks (8,28,53,45,9) corroborate. All 108 incidence-preserving point permutations are enumerated; signed face Lefschetz traces give the exact degree-3 character and zero invariant average.

originality.rationale: Targeted research-record searches, claim comparisons, direct literature queries, and the relevant primary text sections found no statement or broader theorem implying this exact integral wedge decomposition together with its full 108-element rational point-group character. Kim--Kim prove bounds and tight path/cycle classifications, Santhanam--Shukla--Singh prove collapsibility bounds, and Abdallah--Schenck examine a distinct monomial OS ideal and its graded algebraic Betti numbers using the same Pappus incidence triples. The incidence triples themselves are known; only the stated topological and character classification is proposed. Equivalent unindexed calculations remain possible.

value.rationale: The self-dual Pappus (9_3) configuration is a canonical geometry with substantial incidence symmetry. Its noncover complex has pure dimension 5 but a rank-10 homology group solely in dimension 3, making exact integral homotopy and non-shellability a motivated structural classification. Its full rational character has trace distinctions invisible to point cycle types and no invariant subspace, yielding additional nontrivial symmetry information. These facts are not generic bounds, arbitrary slices, or mere f-vector computation.
